# Pull Request Template

## Notes & Questions for the Reviewer
- Are there any fields that should be nullable / optional?
- Is the validation level appropriate?
- Any logic or UI that should be refactored or moved?
- General feedback or concerns?


## What has been changed?
Briefly describe what was implemented or modified in the frontend.


## Why did I make these changes?
Explain why these changes were necessary.


## UI / Components affected
- Component name(s):
- Page / route:


## Screenshots (if applicable)
Before:
After:


## How can others test this?
1. Check out the branch
2. Run `npm install` (if needed)
3. Run `npm run dev`
4. Navigate to the relevant page / feature
5. Test edge cases (empty state, error state, loading)

## Checklist before submitting PR
Check each box by adding an `x` → `[x]`

- [ ] I have tested the feature locally
- [ ] No console errors or warnings
- [ ] Code follows project coding standards
- [ ] Components are reusable where appropriate
- [ ] Accessibility has been considered
- [ ] Responsive behavior has been considered/tested


# For the reviewer:

## Checklist before merging
Check each box by adding an `x` → `[x]`

- [ ] UI matches Figma design
- [ ] Code is readable and maintainable
- [ ] No unnecessary complexity
- [ ] Edge cases are handled
- [ ] Naming and structure make sense
